flags.headline: Persisting: Q2 miss / Bitcoin-leverage thesis unchanged, flat session
flags.detail: MARA closed flat (-0.11%, $9.20) on a quiet weekend-adjacent session with no fresh catalyst. The underlying thesis hit from the 8/6 Q2 report stands: Q2 revenue of $174.9M (-27% YoY) and a $1.60/share loss, both well short of consensus ($203.7M rev / +$0.26 EPS expected). Cantor Fitzgerald cut its price target to $12 from $14 post-print; Rosenblatt maintained Buy. No new deterioration today, but no resolution either -- this remains an open thesis hit, not a stabilized position.
flags.thesis_link: Matches MARA key_risk: 'Persistent GAAP losses ... driven by Bitcoin price volatility and mark-to-market accounting create existential risk' and 'Revenue concentration in Bitcoin mining means MARA's financial performance is essentially a leveraged derivative of Bitcoin price.' The Q2 miss is that risk materializing, first flagged 2026-08-06.

evidence.source: Benzinga -- What's Going On With MARA Holdings Stock?

flags.headline: Persisting: Aug 31 wildfire-liability-reform deadline, 16 days out, unresolved
flags.detail: EIX +1.07% today ($71.43) -- calm price action, but the underlying catalyst is unchanged and the clock is shorter. Edison's CEO has publicly warned that a failure to pass California wildfire-liability reform by the Aug 31 legislative deadline could trigger utility credit downgrades. Governor Newsom is making an eleventh-hour push (limiting attorneys' fees, capping local-government recoupment) but is facing organized pushback from wildfire-survivor advocates who argue the proposal would limit victim compensation. No bill has passed as of this run.
flags.thesis_link: Matches EIX key_risk: 'Elevated debt-to-equity of 216% amplifies financial risk from future wildfire events, adverse rate case outcomes ... a single catastrophic fire in SCE's territory could create material liability' and 'California's complex regulatory and political environment creates uncertainty around cost recovery ... wildfire liability frameworks.'

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance -- Edison International (EIX) CEO Warns Wildfire Reform Delay Could Trigger Credit Downgrades
CalMatters -- Newsom makes last-minute push to help California utilities facing wildfire bills
